setup.managersOnlyTitle: Fee setup is for the owner and admins
setup.managersOnlyText: To change fee heads, amounts, concessions or fine rules, ask the owner or an admin. You can keep collecting fees, checking bKash/Nagad payments and closing the day as before.

errors.duplicate: One with this name already exists. Use another name.
errors.noCurrentYear: There is no current academic year. Make one current in institute setup first.
errors.invalidHead: This leaves the fee head incomplete: check the day of the month and the fine amounts.
errors.invalidTerm: The due date cannot be before the opening date.
errors.concessionOverlap: This student already has a concession on this fee for that time. End it first, then add the new one.
errors.invalidEnd: It cannot end before it starts. To cancel one that has not started, end it on its start date.
errors.differentFamilies: These students are in two different families. Remove one from their family first, then add them.
errors.inUse: Dues or other records use this, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.checkForm: Fix the fields marked in red.

dues.title: Generate and recalculate dues
dues.intro: Dues are generated by themselves every night. Run them now from here when you need to.
dues.generateHint: After adding a fee head or amounts, create today's dues without waiting for the night.
dues.generateBody: Every student gets the dues from the start month up to today that do not exist yet. Existing dues do not change. It runs in the background and may take a few minutes.
dues.generateStarted: Generating dues. It runs in the background and will finish in a few minutes.
dues.recalculateHint: When fee heads, amounts, concessions or fine rules change, dues created earlier keep their old amounts. Run this to apply the new setup to dues with nothing paid.
dues.recalculateBody: Dues with nothing paid and no fine waived get their amount, concession and fine rule from today's setup. Dues paid in part or in full, receipts and due dates do not change. It runs in the background.
dues.recalculateStarted: Recalculating. It runs in the background and will finish in a few minutes.
dues.setStartFirst: Set and save the month dues start first.
dues.studentsBody: Their dues with nothing paid get the new amounts and concessions. Dues with a payment do not change. You can also do it later from Start and general.
dues.studentsUpdated: {count, plural, one {{n} due updated} other {{n} dues updated}}

general.title: Start and general
general.intro: The month dues start, the receipt SMS, the note on receipts and the sibling rule.
general.notSavedYetText: These are the starting values. Check them and save once.

dues.title: When dues start
dues.label: First month of dues
dues.hint: Dues are created for this month and the months after it, never for earlier months. Starting mid-year? Choose the current month.
dues.notYetNote: No dues are created until the first month is set.

receipt.title: Receipts
receipt.smsHint: After a payment, the guardian gets an SMS, which also catches cash taken without a receipt. It shares the daily SMS limit with absence SMS.
receipt.noteHint: Printed on every receipt, such as office hours or the refund rule.
receipt.notePlaceholder: e.g. Fees paid are not refundable.

sibling.title: Sibling discount
sibling.label: Sibling rule
sibling.hint: Applies only in confirmed families, and only on fee heads with the sibling discount turned on. The student in the highest class pays in full. If someone also has their own concession, the larger one applies, never both.
sibling.summaryPercent: From the {from} child on, each pays {value}% less on eligible fees.
sibling.summaryFixed: From the {from} child on, each pays {amount} less on every eligible due.

heads.title: Fee heads
heads.hint: What money is collected for, how often, when it is due and the late fine. Fee heads are never deleted, only turned off.
heads.emptyText: Add heads such as monthly tuition, admission or exam fees, then set each class's amount under Amounts.
heads.ruleYearlyStart: The first day of the academic year
heads.ruleYearly: {days} days after the academic year starts
heads.ruleOnceFrom: charged by itself to students admitted on or after {date}
heads.finePerDayRule: {amount} for each day late, at most {cap}
heads.deactivateBody: No new dues will be created for it. Dues already created, payments and receipts stay as they are. You can turn it on again later.
heads.activateBody: New dues will be created for it again where it has amounts.
heads.changedNotice: The new rule applies to dues created from now on. To apply it to earlier dues with nothing paid, recalculate.
heads.createdNotice: Fee head added. Now set each class's amount under Amounts; without an amount no dues are created for it.
heads.dialogHint: Give the name in both languages; receipts and the guardian app show it.
heads.dueDay: Day of the month it is due
heads.dueDayHint: A fine starts if it is unpaid after this day.
heads.offsetYearly: Days after the academic year starts
heads.oneTimeFrom: Charge students admitted on or after
heads.oneTimeFromHint: Leave empty to never charge it by itself.
heads.perTermHint: Each term's due date is the last day to pay. Set the dates under Terms.
heads.fineHint: When it is still unpaid after the due date.
heads.fineCapHint: At least the fine per day.
heads.siblingEligible: Sibling discount applies to this fee
heads.errorOffset: Enter a number of days from 0 to 365.
heads.errorFineCap: Make the largest fine at least the fine per day.
heads.errorDuplicate: Another active fee head has this name.

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.intro: How much each {classLevel} pays for each fee head, per academic year. An empty cell means that fee is not charged there.
amounts.noYearText: Add an academic year in institute setup first.
amounts.gridHint: Type amounts in the cells, in Bangla or English digits. All cells are saved together.
amounts.yearSaveFirst: Save or cancel to change the year.
amounts.noHeadsText: Add heads such as monthly tuition under Fee heads first.
amounts.noClassesText: Add a {classLevel} in institute setup first.
amounts.groupsHint: The inner rows set separate amounts by {group}. Leave a cell empty to use the row above; type 0 to make it free.
amounts.savedNotice: The new amounts apply to dues created from now on. To apply them to earlier dues with nothing paid, recalculate.
amounts.invalidCells: {count, plural, one {{n} cell is not an amount} other {{n} cells are not amounts}}
amounts.changedCells: {count, plural, one {{n} cell changed, not saved} other {{n} cells changed, not saved}}
amounts.copyHint: The chosen year's amounts fill only the empty cells; cells that already have an amount do not change.
amounts.copied: {count, plural, one {{n} amount copied} other {{n} amounts copied}}
amounts.copiedNone: Nothing copied: there were no empty cells, or that year has no amounts.

terms.title: Terms
terms.hint: A “per term” fee gets a due for every term; the term's due date is the last day to pay.
terms.noYearText: Add an academic year in institute setup first.
terms.noPerTermHeads: There is no “per term” fee head yet. Terms are only needed for those.
terms.emptyText: For example first term, half-yearly, annual: give each an opening date and a due date.
terms.dialogHint: The fee's late fine starts when it is still unpaid after the due date.
terms.errorDueBeforeOpen: The due date cannot be before the opening date.
terms.errorDuplicate: This year already has a term with this name.
terms.deleteBody: Only a term with no dues yet can be deleted. If it has dues, change its name or dates instead.

picker.placeholder: Name, ID, roll or guardian's phone
picker.hint: Bangla or English digits; at least 2 characters.

concessions.findHint: Find the student, then choose the fee, how much and from when. Concessions are never deleted; they are ended with a reason.
concessions.listHint: Running ones first, ended ones after.
concessions.noYear: There is no current academic year. Make one current in institute setup first.
concessions.emptyText: Find a student above to give one.
concessions.addHint: It applies to dues falling due on or after the start date. One fee head never has two concessions at once.
concessions.head: Fee head
concessions.validFromHint: Applies to dues falling due on or after this date.
concessions.fixedHint: Never more than the due itself.
concessions.reasonHint: Helps later, e.g. a teacher's child.
concessions.errorReason: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.
concessions.errorEndBeforeStart: It cannot end before it starts.
concessions.endHint: The {value} concession no longer applies to dues falling due on or after this date. Earlier dues and payments do not change.
concessions.endedOnHint: To cancel one that has not started, give its start date.

siblings.title: Siblings
siblings.intro: Students who share a guardian's phone show here as possible siblings. Many guardians give a relative's phone, so the sibling discount applies only after you confirm.
siblings.rulePercent: From the {from} child on, {value}% less on eligible fees.
siblings.ruleFixed: From the {from} child on, {amount} less on every eligible due.
siblings.ruleOffLink: Turn it on in Start and general
siblings.suggestionsHint: Keep ticked the ones you know are siblings and confirm; untick the rest.
siblings.familiesHint: The student in the highest class pays in full; in the same class, whoever was admitted first. Removing someone needs a reason.
siblings.familiesNoneText: Confirm one from the suggestions above, or add siblings with different phones yourself.
siblings.removeHint: The others' order is worked out again, so some discounts may change.
siblings.errorReason: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.
siblings.alreadyInThis: This student is already in this family.
siblings.newFamilyHint: If the guardian gave different phones, find the siblings here and choose them (2 to 10).
siblings.recalcTitle: {count, plural, one {Recalculate this student's unpaid dues now?} other {Recalculate these {n} students' unpaid dues now?}}

numbers.title: bKash/Nagad numbers
numbers.hint: The institute's own numbers, where guardians send money and submit the TrxID. A receipt is made only after you check it in your own app.
numbers.ownerOnly: Only the owner changes where money goes. You can see the numbers.
numbers.emptyText: Add a bKash or Nagad number and guardians will see it in the app to send money.
numbers.emptyTextAdmin: Numbers the owner adds will show here.
numbers.addHint: A number cannot be changed later; if it is wrong, turn it off and add a new one.
numbers.label: Name or note (optional)
numbers.labelHint: Guardians see it, e.g. Office bKash.
numbers.labelOnlyHint: The number cannot be changed; only its name or note.
numbers.deactivateBody: Guardians will no longer see this number or be able to report money sent to it. Earlier receipts stay as they are.
numbers.activateBody: Guardians can send money to this number again.

collectors.title: Fee collectors
collectors.hint: Who can take money at the counter, give receipts and check bKash/Nagad payments. Roles are changed on the staff page.
collectors.teacherNote: A teacher can collect fees as well as teach: on the staff page, open the menu beside their name and choose “Give fee collection”.
collectors.canManage: Collects, voids receipts, waives fines and sets up fees
collectors.canCollect: Collects, gives receipts, checks bKash/Nagad and closes their own day
